[EN] The Freeholds is kind of a big, scary place, wouldn't you say?

That's why my brothers and I came: to help people get around during Rootstock.

But after the festival, you're on your own!
[ES] The Freeholds es un lugar bastante grande y aterrador, ¿no dirías?

Por eso vinimos mis hermanos y yo: para ayudar a la gente a trasladarse durante Rootstock.

¡Pero después del festival, estarás por tu cuenta!
